summary: Flushing Financial Corp. filed an 8-K announcing receipt of all required regulatory approvals for its acquisition by OceanFirst Financial Corp. under a merger agreement dated December 29, 2025. The Federal Reserve Board approved on April 24, 2026, following NYDFS and OCC approvals in March/April 2026. No further regulatory approvals are required; closing is anticipated by June 1, 2026. Terms such as price per share, premium, and consideration are not disclosed in this filing. The transaction involves Flushing Bank merging into OceanFirst Bank. The risk-arb angle focuses on satisfaction of remaining closing conditions and timeline to close.
